title: finding(fields): readFileValue throws URIError for a file URL whose last segment holds a bare `%` — nameFromUrl calls decodeURIComponent unguarded, on the render path of every file and image cell
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the `out_of_scope_findings` (class a) of the objectui#10493 dev report. The at-tier contract review of PR objectui#10575 confirmed the site at source. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

`nameFromUrl` in `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.ts` takes a URL's last path segment as the display name and passes it to `decodeURIComponent` without a guard. A segment holding a bare `%` (not a valid escape) makes it throw `URIError: URI malformed`, and `readFileValue` throws with it.

## Reproduction (the dev's, relayed; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

`node --experimental-strip-types` on `file-value.ts`:
- `readFileValue('https://cdn.example.com/100%.png')` ⇒ throws.
- `readFileValue({ url: 'https://cdn.example.com/a%zz.pdf' })` ⇒ throws.

Both throw at the objectui#10493 base `f94cfa5` and at its head. Since PR objectui#10575, a `data:` URI returns before the decode, so `data:text/plain,100%` no longer throws.

## Reach

`@objectstack/spec`'s `FileValueSchema` declares `url: z.string()`, so such a value passes the contract. `readFileValue` runs during render in `FileCellRenderer`, `ImageCellRenderer` (through `displayableImagesOf`), `FileField`, `FileCell` and `ImageField`. ⛔ The render-time crash itself is NOT MEASURED: whether an error boundary contains it, and what the user sees, is the claimant's first measurement.

## Dedupe

Semantic search of this repo, including closed issues:
- 「nameFromUrl decodeURIComponent URIError URI malformed readFileValue percent sign」 ⇒ 0 hits.
- Control, 「data URI image alt base64 nameFromUrl signature cell」 ⇒ objectui#10493, so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `nameFromUrl URIError` · `decodeURIComponent URI malformed` · `readFileValue percent sign` · `file cell malformed URL crash`
